sources.cpu_watts_per_vcpu: Cloud Carbon Footprint coefficients, coefficients-gcp-use.csv, EPYC 2nd Gen "Max Watts" 1.575187 per vCPU (Apache-2.0). https://github.com/cloud-carbon-footprint/ccf-coefficients/blob/main/output/coefficients-gcp-use.csv
sources.family_max_vcpus: Cloud Carbon Footprint embodied emissions method: resources reserved / largest instance vCPUs in the family; n2d-standard-224 has 224 vCPUs. https://www.cloudcarbonfootprint.org/docs/embodied-emissions
sources.flow_credits_per_run: GitLab Credits dashboard, Automated flow usage for the ModelGate service account, one run. Not yet measured.
sources.grid_intensity_gco2e_per_kwh: Google Cloud, Carbon free energy for Google Cloud regions, 2025 data: us-east1 grid carbon intensity 579 gCO2eq/kWh (location-based, from Electricity Maps). https://cloud.google.com/sustainability/region-carbon
sources.memory_watts_per_gb: Cloud Carbon Footprint methodology: memory 0.000392 kWh per GB-hour. https://www.cloudcarbonfootprint.org/docs/methodology/
sources.pue: Cloud Carbon Footprint methodology: GCP PUE 1.1, from Google's published PUE. https://www.cloudcarbonfootprint.org/docs/methodology/
sources.runner: GitLab docs, Hosted runners on Linux: saas-linux-small-amd64 has 2 vCPUs and 8 GB, runs on Google Cloud Compute Engine, default region us-east1. https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/runners/hosted_runners/linux/
sources.server_embodied_kgco2e: Cloud Carbon Footprint coefficients, coefficients-gcp-embodied.csv, n2d-standard-2, EPYC 2nd Gen, total 2321.46 kgCO2e per server. https://github.com/cloud-carbon-footprint/ccf-coefficients/blob/main/output/coefficients-gcp-embodied.csv
sources.server_lifespan_years: Cloud Carbon Footprint embodied emissions method: 4-year expected lifespan. https://www.cloudcarbonfootprint.org/docs/embodied-emissions

not_measured: The GitLab Duo flow run (card writing, merge request): it executes on GitLab's agent platform and model provider, which publish no per-run energy data.
Image pull and container start before the job script; the job duration starts at CI_JOB_STARTED_AT.
Network transfer for pip downloads and API calls.
